domain: Subtracting fractions and mixed numbers (including regrouping and simplification)

skills.name: Common denominator conversion
skills.definition: Determine a least common denominator (LCD/LCM) and rewrite one or both fractions as equivalent fractions with that common denominator before subtracting.
inclusion_criteria: The work explicitly finds an LCD/LCM for two different denominators
The work rewrites fractions to equivalent forms with a shared denominator as preparation for subtraction
exclusion_criteria: Denominators are already the same and subtraction proceeds without any denominator conversion
The work only rewrites a whole number as a fraction/mixed number (tag S03 instead)

skills.name: Subtract like-denominator fractions
skills.definition: Subtract fractions that already share a denominator by subtracting numerators and keeping the common denominator (allowing 0 or negative intermediate results).
inclusion_criteria: The work performs a/b − c/b = (a−c)/b (including 0/b or negative results)
The work subtracts the fractional parts within a mixed-number subtraction after denominators are aligned
exclusion_criteria: The work only converts to a common denominator without performing the subtraction (tag S01 instead)
The work only reduces/simplifies or converts the final form without showing the subtraction operation (tag S04 instead)

skills.name: Rewrite mixed/whole forms
skills.definition: Rewrite mixed numbers or whole numbers into a form suitable for subtraction, such as converting mixed to improper fractions or expressing a whole number as an equivalent fraction/mixed number with a chosen denominator.
inclusion_criteria: Converts a mixed number to an improper fraction (including interpreting nonstandard mixed numbers like 1 4/3 as 1 + 4/3)
Rewrites a whole number as a mixed number with 0 fractional part (e.g., 2 = 2 0/8) or as an equivalent fraction with a specified denominator (e.g., 4 = 12/3)
exclusion_criteria: The work only finds an LCD and converts proper fractions to that denominator (tag S01 instead)
The work borrows/regroups between whole and fractional parts due to a negative fractional difference (tag S04 instead)

skills.name: Regroup and simplify result
skills.definition: Regroup/borrow between whole and fractional parts when needed and present the final answer in simplest appropriate form (reduce and/or convert between improper fractions, mixed numbers, and integers).
inclusion_criteria: Borrows 1 from the whole part and converts it to fractional units (adds b/b) to make the fractional subtraction nonnegative
Reduces a resulting fraction to lowest terms and/or converts an improper fraction to a mixed number or integer as the final presentation
exclusion_criteria: The work only performs common-denominator conversion (tag S01 instead)
The work only performs numerator subtraction with like denominators without any regrouping or final-form simplification (tag S02 instead)
